query:
SELECT team_home_id as "team_home_id?",
                   team_away_id as "team_away_id?",
                   score_home   as "score_home?",
                   score_away   as "score_away?",
                   status
            FROM matches
            WHERE stage = 'final'::match_stage AND status = 'finished'
            ORDER BY kickoff_time DESC
            LIMIT 1
